tasks.short: Maintain student attendance and grade records

steps.what: Check attendance observations, awarded grades and student record identities
Transfer attendance, grades and other required records into their destinations
Reconcile student records and accept the official update

tasks.design: Test native record import and synchronisation between the {LMS} and {OTHER} student registry. Transfer verified facts as a draft; the lecturer resolves discrepancies and accepts the official update.
tasks.previous_blocker: Separate teaching and official record systems can require duplicate entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native import and mapping can move already verified facts without retyping.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving wrong identities, disputed attendance and superseded grades.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish an authorised correction from a conflicting source.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated record entry; grade decisions and corrections remain human.

reach.learn: Use correct session and student identifiers

evidence.claim: Radboud requires Brightspace grades also to be published in OSIRIS, documenting a dual-system record requirement rather than a measured saving.
Configured transfer and effort estimates are an unmeasured proposal.

assumptions: Boundary is maintaining records, excluding grade determination, physical attendance observation and student notification.

Lecturer verifies student id, course, session/assessment id, attendance status, awarded grade, result version and authorised correction in s1. Structured capture and source checks retain35%; absent identifiers require manual reconciliation, never inferred attendance.
Examiners produce awarded grades in the assessment task; observation producers retain their existing observation work. No saving is transferred from them.
OTHER means student registry. Test native synchronisation and imports first; existing runtime and already automated entry earn no saving.
unknowns: Official registry, current duplicate entry and available import controls
research_questions: Can native import preserve grade versions and surface mismatched identities?

incremental.description: Maintain mapping checks and correction exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact student ids, source result versions, attendance sessions and destination update batch; changes void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R65 gives35 gross minus6 upkeep=29 net. Existing sync yields zero; repeated manual dual entry may yield7%.

tasks.short: Supervise student teaching, internships and research

steps.what: Supervise student teaching, internship and research work and give corrective guidance

tasks.design: Retain direct observation, scientific guidance and student supervision. Plans in {DOCS} support the conversation without replacing assessment of actual practical work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision depends on student understanding and current research or laboratory conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No verified replacement for direct supervision is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising when a student needs intervention rather than another written instruction.
tasks.human_edge: Judge understanding and guide responsible scientific practice.
tasks.altitude: Supervisory time and authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Recognise conceptual misunderstandings in practical work

evidence.claim: Teaching drafting tools do not demonstrate replacement of direct scientific supervision.

assumptions: Boundary is substantive supervision, excluding separate scheduling and record maintenance.
Student work and observed actions are assessed directly during s1; no structured competent-or-safe flag is assumed.
Test existing teaching tools before additions; no new tool is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no new process or system is introduced.
research_questions: Which student difficulties require direct observation to recognise?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross and net zero. Teaching and research supervision both retain direct guidance.

tasks.short: Compile, administer and grade chemistry examinations

steps.what: Compile examinations, define answer keys and prepare marking rubrics
Check the examination, administer it and collect candidate answers
Mark closed questions against exact answer keys
Grade open answers, inspect proposed scores and accept examination results

tasks.design: Configure exact closed-question marking in the {LMS} from lecturer-defined keys. Retain question design, administration, open-answer judgment and examination result acceptance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fixed-answer scoring repeats a known key for every script.
tasks.enabler_now: Native assessment configuration supports deterministic closed-question marking.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing reasoning, partial credit and scientifically valid alternative answers.
tasks.human_edge: Determine fair marks and detect defects in questions or keys.
tasks.altitude: Less mechanical scoring; examiner authority stays unchanged.

reach.learn: Separate closed responses from reasoning that needs judgment

evidence.claim: Ans automatically marks closed questions and supports distributing open questions among markers.
The closed-question share and effort estimate are unmeasured chemistry examination scenarios.

assumptions: Boundary is examination design through grade acceptance; official record transfer is counted in task5872, not here.

Lecturer captures question ids/versions, exact permitted responses, score weights and rubric in s1. Numeric tolerance is used only if explicitly defined; ambiguous formulae, units and alternate reasoning are manually marked.
Registry supplies existing candidate roster. Lecturer associates candidate and answer ids and checks collection in s2 with all time retained; missing or unreadable answers go to manual handling.
Test native LMS marking first. This split applies to mixed exams with20% baseline mechanical marking; exams already auto-marked or wholly open gain no additional saving.
unknowns: Question formats, existing automatic marking and examination policy
research_questions: Can exact configured keys reproduce examiner-checked closed scores without misclassifying valid alternatives?

already_counted.description: Examination check, administration, open grading and result acceptance

incremental.description: Maintain keys and inspect scoring exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact examination package, questions, keys and rubric; changes require renewed check
Exact candidate answers, score proposals, rubric version and awarded grade set; changes void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gives20 gross minus6 upkeep=14 net. Existing auto-marking or wholly open exams yield zero; mixed exams with repeated mechanical marking may yield4%.

steps.what: Select learning outcomes, chemical content and constraints for course materials
Draft syllabi, homework assignments and handouts from the teaching brief

loop.purpose: Draft teaching explanations and exercises from selected content
loop.input: Materials brief, source passages and lecturer-verified examples
loop.check: Lecturer independently checks equations, quantities, units, explanations and learning alignment
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; uncertain chemistry or procedural content returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates handle layouts but cannot tailor conceptual explanations and exercises

steps.what: Correct scientific content and accept the final course materials

tasks.design: Use {DOCS} templates first, with bounded drafting for explanatory teaching prose. The lecturer checks chemistry and accepts the final materials; laboratory procedures remain based on separately authorised instructions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reusable layouts do not write audience-specific explanations.
tasks.enabler_now: Source constrained drafting can propose editable teaching content.
tasks.still_hard: Finding subtle chemical errors in plausible explanations or example solutions.
tasks.human_edge: Choose accurate examples and appropriate learning demands.
tasks.altitude: Less prose drafting while scientific content decisions remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Check whether tasks reveal conceptual understanding

evidence.claim: EduGenAI provides a teaching chat platform; it does not establish chemical accuracy or course preparation savings.
The proposed source constrained materials workflow and effort estimates are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is course material preparation, excluding teaching, publishing and authorising laboratory procedures.

Lecturer captures outcomes, audience, timetable, source passages/versions, notation, checked examples and assignment requirements in s1. Capture time remains; absent reliable content triggers manual writing.
Generated prose cannot establish safe experiments; existing authorised laboratory instructions are referenced unchanged and checked by the lecturer.
Test native DOCS layouts and reuse before the loop; no student personal data are required.
unknowns: Reusable source quality and approved drafting environment
research_questions: Does independent scientific checking leave any total preparation saving?

already_counted.description: Content selection and source brief capture
Draft review, independent scientific check and final correction

incremental.description: Maintain drafting examples and inspect recurring errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact materials version, examples, source versions and referenced laboratory instructions; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R88 gives12 gross minus6 upkeep=6 net. Novel or error-prone content may require full rewriting; routine handouts may yield2%.
